# Pesher Habakkuk Column 5 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Pesher Habakkuk Column 5 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 5:2 — "You shall not die" vs. "We will not die"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "You-shall-not-die" | Follows 1QpHab reading (2ms) |
| LOGOS | "You shall not die" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "We will not die" | Follows MT tiqqun sopherim tradition |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "You shall not die" (EMET/LOGOS). 1QpHab preserves the original reading before scribal emendation (tiqqun sopherim). This is the DSS translation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 5:7 — "rebuke" vs. "correction" vs. "punishment"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "by-their-rebuke" | Hebrew tokachah |
| LOGOS | "by their rebuke" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "through their correction" | Dynamic synonym |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "by their rebuke" (EMET/LOGOS). "Rebuke" is the standard rendering of tokachah in this context.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 5:16 — "rejected" vs. "threw out"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "who-rejected" | Hebrew ma'as |
| LOGOS | "who rejected" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "who threw out" | Vivid dynamic rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "who rejected" (EMET/LOGOS). More dignified register appropriate for the legal/covenantal context.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---
*Total disagreements in Column 5: 3 | Covers Hab 1:12-13*
